<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="spiritual-warriors" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Spiritual Warriors</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Spiritual warriors have four different variants, each resembling their respective god within the God Wars Dungeon. They're mostly similar, except that Armadylean spiritual warriors </nowiki><strong><nowiki>can't</nowiki></strong><nowiki> be attacked with melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This guide will focus on killing spiritual warriors in the Sunken Pyramid, as this location yields the highest kills per hour</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Other methods of killing spiritual warriors, such as in the God Wars Dungeon will not be discussed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ They can be assigned as a slayer assignment </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> by Jacquelyn, The Raptor, Vannaka, Sumona, and Laniakea</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They count as spiritual warriors, ghosts, and undead slayer tasks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Armadylean spiritual warriors also count as aviansie slayer tasks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 68</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• level 99 Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is required to access the Sunken Pyramid</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 231</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~1170 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~1000 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (All AFK)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: ~270k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~231k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (All AFK)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="desirable-drops"><nowiki>Desirable Drops</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Spiritual warriors have a valuable loot table containing: coins </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1134866724043358218.png?v=1" alt="goldacc" title="goldacc" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, salvage </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1130170723130937427.png?v=1" alt="springcleaner" title="springcleaner" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, super sets </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735230908805240.png?v=1" alt="notepaper" title="notepaper" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and a variety of herb drops </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1134863720128974940.png?v=1" alt="herbbag" title="herbbag" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sealed clue scroll (hard) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1123586945273049109.png?v=1" alt="hardclue" title="hardclue" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Warpriest armour </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158477033474.png?v=1" alt="armadylcomp" title="armadylcomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435429861261322.png?v=1" alt="bandoscomp" title="bandoscomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583435429785632769.png?v=1" alt="saradomincomp" title="saradomincomp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/607288026334232576.png?v=1" alt="zamorakcomp" title="zamorakcomp" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They will drop warpriest armour for their respective faction, so they are a good source of god components</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="useful-items-and-unlocks"><nowiki>Useful Items and Unlocks</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>


</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Items</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Salve_amulet_(e) <nowiki>Salve amulet (e)</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Increases damage and accuracy by 20% when fighting undead monsters
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ghost_hunter_equipment <nowiki>Ghost hunter equipment</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/855865893808767016.png?v=1" alt="ghosthunterhelm" title="ghosthunterhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Increases damage done against ghosts related creatures by 10% when three or more pieces are worn
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_Codex <nowiki>Slayer Codex</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1" alt="slayercodex" title="slayercodex" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Once 50 souls are added, it can be used to teleport to the Sunken Pyramid
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Herbicide <nowiki>Herbicide</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1134923280625709106.png?v=1" alt="herbicide" title="herbicide" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Herb_bag <nowiki>Herb bag</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1134863720128974940.png?v=1" alt="herbbag" title="herbbag" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • With the herbicide collector upgrade you will automatically loot herbs
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Abilities</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Magma_Tempest <nowiki>Magma Tempest</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1" alt="magmatempest" title="magmatempest" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Chain <nowiki>Greater Chain</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_Sunshine <nowiki>Greater Sunshine</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Other</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Luck_of_the_Dwarves_(relic_power) <nowiki>Luck of the Dwarves (relic power)</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/987267727980912701.png?v=1" alt="lotdrelic" title="lotdrelic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Allows you to increase your kph by wearing a better ring
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><nowiki>Location and How to Get there</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The best place to kill spiritual warriors is in the Sunken Pyramid due to how spread out they are in other locations. You can teleport there with a teleport to house tablet, or with a Slayer Codex </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1" alt="slayercodex" title="slayercodex" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spiritual warriors will only spawn as the version you captured</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-magic-and-melee"><ins><nowiki>Method: Magic and Melee</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Spiritual warriors can be AFK'd for extended periods with minimal inputs required</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is possible to AFK them with only one input every 10 minutes</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sacrifice </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065907322880.png?v=1" alt="sacrifice" title="sacrifice" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is used to help sustain your life points</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ They're aggressive to you if you're not wearing any armour for their respective faction; however, using aggression potions </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will net you a higher kph and requires less inputs</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you're using melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> you can't have Armadylean spiritual warriors</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="where-to-stand"><nowiki>Where to stand</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ With your camera facing north, center yourself between the northern statue and the two green pots to the east</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/t6Us9dgqjv.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="presets"><nowiki>Presets</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=l8ENoGbUVvKoUYXGKP1X <nowiki>Melee</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/4c87df13846b8b4bfa0f494d3291cee670f84f7faf5d2c16d9b10b7c28cecbf6.webp" alt="Spiritual Warriors Magic bis" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=a9a3a18d-fe08-486d-8f09-628cf1cb3ad6 <nowiki>Magic (Alternative)</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/d9f29fbfdf3b1021a47180f2925777f6dc1a25b1f148c73b9968dade2ae96244.webp" alt="Spiritual Warriors alt" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=94de33d3-7969-4808-ac20-6f6f7fc819df <nowiki>Magic (Best in Slot)</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F94de33d3-7969-4808-ac20-6f6f7fc819df.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The alternative Magic preset can be used for accounts with minimal unlocks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917553520680.png?v=1" alt="inquisitorstaff" title="inquisitorstaff" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Air Wave will do the same damage as Air Surge, but use less runes</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Precise 6 Caroming 1 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1" alt="p6" title="p6" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1043953962207957162.png?v=1" alt="caroming1" title="caroming1" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + Eruptive 4 Ruthless 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416401561952296.png?v=1" alt="er4" title="er4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800572883025.png?v=1" alt="ruthless3" title="ruthless3" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are the best weapon perks if only doing this method</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><strong><nowiki>Note:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> You can place </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="tuskas" title="tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> further up if on task.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Magic (Best in Slot)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/O8zD1FFqoa.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Magic (Alternative)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/4ZVzO6qmU2.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Melee</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/o2prKTfAlU.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
 ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Chaos Roar </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644356671737966.png?v=1" alt="chaosroar" title="chaosroar" kind="icon" /><nowiki> isn't unlocked, shift the rest of the abilities forward</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
